about.title: About Me
about.description: Aya Khlif is a Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years building SaaS platforms, government ERP systems, e-commerce, delivery and real-estate solutions. Currently a Full Stack Software Engineer at Hama Governorate, building internal government systems, most notably the governorate ERP. Previously worked on a multi-tenant SaaS product at Wasmware (NestJS, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Traefik, API gateway), including payment gateway integration and ZATCA Phase 2 e-invoicing.

hama.name: Hama Governorate
hama.desc: Build and maintain multiple internal government systems, the main one being the governorate ERP. Modules: finance (fiscal years, payment orders, revenue collection, budget amendments), budget lines & account codes, procurement & maintenance (purchase requests, tenders, committees, supplier portal), and HR workflows (employee advances). Work with stakeholders and QA to turn administrative procedures into multi-step approval workflows.

wasmware.desc: Worked on a multi-tenant SaaS platform with NestJS, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Traefik and an API gateway. Integrated payment gateways and ZATCA Phase 2 (Fatoora) e-invoicing.
